items.title: Why Novo Nordisk investors feel disappointed today
items.summary: Novo Nordisk (NVO) stock is dipping after the company's outlook disappointed investors. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his thoughts on the stock, the company's trajectory, and where Eli Lilly (LLY) fits into the equation.
